{{Quote|Besides, don't you still have that other gizmo Nick Rostu gave you?"<br>"The lightwhip? Yes, but it's not very good for close combat, or multiple opponents.|[[Den Dhur]] and [[Jax Pavan]]|<ref name="CNII:SOS" />}}
A '''[[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]]''' belonged to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Drach Coven]] and [[Mok]]. They kept it aboard their ship the ''[[Far Ranger]].'' Eventually they were arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] when they delivered Nick Rostu to the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. Nick was blackmailed and threatened by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to find [[Jax Pavan]]. Nick was given the ''Far Ranger'' for his hunt and while aboard he found the lightwhip, musing that it looked like a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Rostu theorized it was from one of Coven and Mok's plunders from a distant planet. Given he was in flight he didn't activate it. Later in the Factory District, after almost being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], Nick told Jax about the peculiar weapon he had on him. Jax took the whip and turned to face Xizor, who had Pavan's [[Jax Pavan's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. Pavan used the whip to fight the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Prince. Jax had trained with whips during his time at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], but not as much as lightsabers. Despite Xizor coming close to killing Jax various times, Jax was eventually able to reclaim his lightsaber from the Prince, causing the Xizor to flee. Jax sensed Vader approaching, so he made the decision to hand his lightsaber to [[I-5YQ]] so he could drop the lightsaber and let it cut its way down to the reactor core, causing an explosion, which Jax hoped would also take Vader with it, or at least make Vader think Pavan was dead. During Jax, [[Den Dhur]], [[Laranth Tarak]], I-Five, Nick and [[Kaird|Kaird's]] escape they came across Vader's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Jax used the whip to strike the shuttles forward repulsorlift vanes, keeping the shuttle grounded. The [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann|Haninum Tyk Rhinaan]], Vader's aide-de-camp, came face to face with Jax, wanting to escape with his life and escape the horror of Vader. Jax took him and lead him to his freighter. Jax and his comrades escaped the reactor cores explosion with only ten seconds to spare.<ref name="CNI:JT" /> The following several months afterward, Jax discarded using the weapon-though he still keptit around-in favor of a [[Jax Pavan's vibrosword|vibrosword]]. During a conversation with his comrades about finding a new lightsaber, Den Dhur mentioned the lightwhip as an alternative. Jax explained that he didn't use it anymore due to it not being very good up close and not good against multiple enemies.<ref name="CNII:SOS" /> Following the [[Ambush near the Twins|ambush]] near the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]], Jax Pavan escaped the crashing [[Far Ranger]] with only his [[Jax Pavan's third lightsaber|third lightsaber]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] old [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]], his [[Miisai|miisai tree]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[SD41263.I]].<ref name="Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

==Description==
When Nick found the whip, he mused that it looked like a power handle and was reminiscent of a lightsaber hilt, though the emission aperture was smaller than a lightsaber's. Its metal core's length was elastic to a limited degree. The whip had a thick thong near the hilt. The whip's cord was contained inside its hilt and when activated the whip would extend to twice the length of Jax Pavan's lightsaber when it was fully extended. The cracks the lightwhip could make were capable of breaking the sound barrier.<ref name="CNI:JT" />

It had [[Color/Legends|green]] energy,<ref name="CNI:JT" /> plasmatic<ref name="CNII:SOS" /> field around its supple metal cord. The energy could be controlled, as when flicked, the energy would rush down the cord to the tip. The energy was also strong enough to cut into and through metals with ease such as one of the Factory Distict's control room floors, [[Feral droid|feral]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and a Lambda-Class shuttles repulsorlift vanes.<ref name="CNI:JT" />
